additional_reconciled_findings.C4P: Later canonical evidence shows L2/QS1/QS2/HE2 did not cross R2 on their preregistered views; FMC/SMVE is the distinct physical reduction family with repeated bounded frontier-crossing evidence.
additional_reconciled_findings.C4Q: On exposed D13 fixed-water-table relaxation, all frozen LARE members R3-R16 qualify. R4 is minimum reduced LARE crossing R2 on all five frozen views; R12 is the only reduced LARE member crossing FMC on all five.
additional_reconciled_findings.C4R: Blind B01 validation replicated the comparator-relative separation: minimum R4 for the frozen GW vector and R12 for FMC-relative PROFILE crossing on the 64-step validation workload.
additional_reconciled_findings.C4S: A full same-workload CoRichards common cohort became available for the subsequent value screen; this comparator availability does not establish hydrological superiority.
additional_reconciled_findings.C4T: Shared-host purpose-dependent relative cost-fidelity evidence was resolved, but it supplies neither application acceptance nor a portable speedup claim.
additional_reconciled_findings.C4U: Groundwater application acceptance is blocked on externally governed H_app plus independent A_temporal or a direct temporal head-error budget with immutable provenance.
additional_reconciled_findings.C4V: On the 1.024-day B01 fixed-water-table persistence test, the minimum transferred lower-zone member persistently crossing both R2 and FMC moved to R8.
additional_reconciled_findings.C4W: The B01 one-day spurious reversal mechanism was characterized without authorizing closure retuning.
additional_reconciled_findings.C4X: Prospective fixed-water-table response transfer to B14 preserved a reduced GW frontier but shifted the minimum transferred-ladder dimension to R3. FMC-relative PROFILE crossing begins at R8. Uniform U4/U8 fail to reproduce the lower-zone-focused groundwater frontier, so state count alone is not a sufficient representation descriptor.
additional_reconciled_findings.C4Y: The first response-blind dynamic prescribed-head transfer produced no representation adjudication because the frozen R2 comparator failed closed under the inherited RS1 local fallback allowance before a complete trajectory existed. C4Y remains closed and is not retuned.
additional_reconciled_findings.C4Z: Fresh blind B01 dynamic prescribed-head validation yields a formal R2-relative minimum R3 for both frozen vectors, but R2 itself misses reversal sequences in 3/4 histories. The lower-zone ladder improves sharply through R8 and lower-zone placement outperforms uniform placement at dimensions 4 and 8.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5A: Matched B14 dynamic-head transfer has no reduced R2-relative GW frontier under the frozen vector. Every lower-zone member fails only pooled absolute mean signed bottom-flux error; R5-R16 plateau on that blocker while placement advantage persists.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5B: Timestep convergence and added lower-zone state above the boundary cell are negligible relative to the C5A residual. Error is confined to prescribed-head phases. BOUNDARY_FACE is strongly sensitive but substantially worse. The unresolved axis is bottom-adjacent spatial thickness under CURRENT_LAYER_FACE.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5C: The B14 dynamic prescribed-head R16/R32/R64 Richards sequence is not yet spatially asymptotic. LARE bottom-cell refinement strongly reduces error relative to R64, but no closure-floor claim is valid until Reference spatial authority is extended.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5D: R128 and R256 qualify and adjacent-grid bottom-flux RMSE decreases twice after R64, but only weakly. Observed orders near 0.06-0.11 do not establish an asymptotic Reference regime.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5E: R512 and R1024 qualify. Adjacent-grid RMSE decreases strongly and descriptive order strengthens to about 0.84, but temporal transaction error remains unreconciled; no continuum Reference is yet admitted.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5F: At R1024, temporal refinement progresses from T1-T2 RMSE ~0.00975 cm/d to T2-T4 ~0.00610. The T4 temporal shift is ~29% of the matched T2 R512-R1024 spatial gap. Spatial gap changes ~9.3% between T1 and T2, so space-time interaction is non-negligible.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5G: The complete R512/R1024 x T1/T2/T4 matrix shows decreasing temporal shifts at both resolutions but a spatial gap that increases from 0.01928 to 0.02107 to 0.02233 cm/d as time is refined. Temporal T2-T4 shifts are subdominant but non-negligible.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5H: At T8, temporal errors shrink with observed order ~0.79-0.84 and are only ~12-15% of the R512-R1024 spatial gap, but that spatial gap still increases to 0.02303 cm/d. One final matched temporal refinement is required before R2048.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5I: At T16 the R512-R1024 spatial bottom-flux RMSE still increases to ~0.02340 cm/d while T8-T16 temporal shifts fall to ~0.00147/0.00180 cm/d (6.3/7.7% of the spatial gap). Temporal error is subdominant; brute-force T32/R2048 is stopped pending prescribed-head boundary-discretization diagnosis.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5J: The prescribed-head spatial gap is strongly boundary-discretization-sensitive. Doubling the half-cell distance worsens the gap by ~31%; arithmetic center-boundary K reduces it only ~2.6%; interaction is ~30% of the larger main effect. No counterfactual is admitted.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5K: On byte-identical C5I states, post-step K and theory-derived arithmetic/integrated/exact-steady half-cell operators all increase the R512-R1024 grid gap; integrated and exact-steady are nearly identical. Pre-step K lag is smaller than the nonlinear spatial correction. No dynamic boundary counterfactual is authorized.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5L: With unchanged G0K0 Reference at T16, R1024-R2048 bottom-flux RMSE falls to ~0.00742 cm/d from ~0.02340 for R512-R1024 (ratio ~0.317, descriptive order ~1.66). Spatial refinement is clearly progressing, but R2048 is not admitted as continuum truth and its temporal error is not independently qualified.
additional_reconciled_findings.CoRichards_Q1: R3-R12 same-partition conventional Richards provide no dynamically qualified reduced common cohort under strict DYN0A authority; R16 alone restores dynamic viability. Q2 is not authorized.
additional_reconciled_findings.cross_axis_gap: C4V, C4X and C4Z cover B01/fixed, B14/fixed and B01/dynamic. The missing B14/dynamic cell is the direct test of material-by-boundary interaction in the current representation hypothesis.
additional_reconciled_findings.interaction_matrix: The B01/B14 x fixed/dynamic matrix is now complete. Material and lower-boundary semantics interact; neither a universal state count nor boundary-only explanation is supported.

next_family_authority.purpose: Separate robust state-placement/purpose findings from comparator-dependent dimension thresholds after the full B14 dynamic-head Reference audit.

fixed_partition_LARE: Conservative standard LARE is physically coherent and resolution-convergent in the bounded DYN0A laboratory.
Low-dimensional fixed partitions are not broadly qualified; critical dynamic storage error decreases strongly with added states and approaches the fine control only at high dimension.
Gradient reconstruction, not conductivity localization, is the dominant bounded internal-flux error mechanism.
C4K did not establish a need for extra history state in the tested BC2 current-state space.
C4L, C4M, C4N and C4O did not establish a transferable zero-fit scalar internal-gradient correction across width and regime.
Further scalar tuning of the same fixed-partition closure is therefore not authorized by current evidence.
purpose_and_value: F-ROMV2 does not require numerical equivalence to fine Richards for a deliberately reduced model.
Application acceptance remains purpose-dependent and has not been adjudicated for this representation boundary.
No speed or production-ROM claim is authorized.
same_partition_CoRichards: R3 was already dynamically blocked under frozen strict Reference numerical authority.
Q1 extended the same comparator to R4, R5, R6, R8 and R12 and found zero qualified non-equilibrium dynamic histories at every reduced dimension through 16 temporal substeps.
R16 exactly reproduces the fine Reference status map and qualifies all seven expected physically in-domain dynamic histories.
Reduced same-partition CoRichards is therefore unavailable as a dynamic equal-dimension comparator in this bounded laboratory under current authority.
This numerical availability result does not imply hydrological superiority of LARE.

retained_controls: Fine Reference Richards remains scientific reference.
R16 remains no-spatial-reduction control, not a ROM.
Standard LARE resolution ladder remains a bounded state-count versus fidelity reference.
CoRichards R3-R12 blocked results remain numerical-availability evidence only.

secondary_representation_note.adaptive_resolution: DYN0A MECH3B supports a nonlinear hydraulic scale transfer mechanism, but current authority does not provide a universal adaptive-grid rule. Adaptive/moving partition design therefore remains a separate future representation choice rather than an inferred next implementation.
